subject: How to graph CPPTRAJ in (ns) instead of timesteps

messages.author: Maghsoud, Yazdan
messages.body:
Dear Amber users,
I want to plot the CPPTRAJ of .mdcrd outputs by Xmgrace to investigate the changing of bond distance vs. time, but it gives me the X-axis in steps instead of time(ns). What should I do to change it?

messages.author: Maria Nagan
messages.body:
Hi-
You can divide the steps by the conversion factor needed to get nanoseconds. For instance if you have ps and you want ns.
I usually make a batch file (bfile) like this:
#Converting ps to ns
s0.x= s0.x/1000
xmgrace -batch bfile
Maria

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Hi,
The 'time' argument can be used pretty much anywhere there is an 'out
<filename' to multiply the X axis values by a factor. So for example,
if your frames correspond to ps but you want nc, use e.g. 'out
myfile.dat time 0.001'.
Hope this helps,
-Dan
